correctness.rationale: Exact differentiation verifies H conservation and U' positivity. The energy levels are compact regular periodic ovals; original-time dt/dx gives I_q and exact density. The Abel kernel g_q has integrable exponential tail for 0≤q<2, a bounded nonzero constant limit at q=2, and exponential growth for q>2. Dominated convergence and an integrable endpoint Laplace limit establish every coefficient, including the beta integral, M2~3E and the supercritical sqrt(pi E/[2(q-2)])A^(q-2) prefactor. Symbolic differentiation gave zero and the standalone independent finite quadrature was executed successfully; numerical checks are not substitutes for the analytic asymptotic proof.

value.rationale: This exact cubic, singled out by the 2023 qualitative global-center classification, has an atypical logarithmic effective potential. Its energy ovals expand exponentially while original physical periods shrink; a full time-sampled position law and its sharp variance-divergence threshold answer a natural dynamical observable question not determined by center existence or period alone. The all-real-order three-regime moment census includes an exact critical coefficient and an exponentially growing supercritical coefficient, useful for distinguishing long excursions from typical residence. This is one unified mathematically motivated result, not a routine reparametrization or an arbitrary finite slice.
